headline: How Bolsonaro's statements destroyed the rainforest
summary: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro contributed to deforestation through statements opposing forest conservation, according to an international study led by the University of Bonn. headline: Exposed ends and bends attract DNA-cutting enzymes, live imaging reveals

To examine the relationship between objective and subjective text difficulty, the researchers investigated the extent to which objective estimates correspond with learners' perceptions. The work is published in the journal Reading and Writing.
